records.jp: なんかここってさー<CR>もう完全にみんなの私物コーナーだよね
records.en_original: This place has turned into a dumping ground for everyone's stuff.
records.en: This place has completely become<CR>everyone’s personal-belongings corner.

records.jp: 私も、ついつい、いろんなもの<CR>置いちゃうんだよねー
records.en_original: Yeah... I tend to leave stuff here myself.
records.en: Yeah... I tend to leave<CR>stuff here myself.

records.jp: あ、この髪どめ可愛い。<CR>誰のかな？
records.en_original: Oh, this hair clip is cute. I wonder whose it is?
records.en: Oh, this hair clip is cute. I wonder<CR>whose it is?

records.jp: この、ペンケースも可愛いよ
records.en_original: The pen case is cute too.
records.en: The pen case is cute too.

records.jp: ……そういえば、お姉ちゃんがよく<CR>可愛いものとか綺麗な物とか集めてたな
records.en_original: This reminds me how Mio always used to collect little things that she thought were cute or pretty...
records.en: ...Come to think of it, Onee-chan<CR>used to collect cute and pretty things.

records.jp: え、美弦さんが？
records.en_original: Really? Mio?
records.en: Really? Mio-san?

records.jp: うん。子供の頃だけどね
records.en_original: Yeah. Back when we were little, though.
records.en: Yeah. Back when we were little, though.

records.jp: お姉ちゃん、日常の中で“特別”を見つけるのが<CR>上手かったんだ。
records.en_original: She was always good at finding something "special" amongst regular stuff.
records.en: Onee-chan was good at finding the "special" in<CR>everyday life.

records.jp: ふたりで拾ったどんぐりとか<CR>縁日で飲んだラムネのビー玉とか……
records.en_original: Like an acorn we found together, or the little marble from a ramune bottle we drank at a festival...
records.en: Like an acorn we found together, or the little<CR>marble from a ramune bottle we drank at a festival...

records.jp: ふたりだけの“特別”を見つけては<CR>大切にとっておいたんだよね
records.en_original: Whenever she found something that was special to the two of us she would always hold on to it.
records.en: Whenever she found something that was special to the<CR>two of us she would always hold on to it.

records.jp: 確かに、小さい頃はそういう宝物がたくさんあったなあ
records.en_original: The world is full of treasures when you're a kid.
records.en: The world is full of treasures when you're a kid.

records.jp: 私も持ってたはずなんだけど、<CR>どこにやったんだっけ……
records.en_original: I had stuff like that too, I wonder where it all went...
records.en: I had stuff like that too, I<CR>wonder where it all went...

records.jp: 大きくなって、そういう感動が薄れていくの、<CR>ちょっと寂しいよね
records.en_original: It's a little sad to see those emotions fade away as you grow older.
records.en: It's a little sad to see those emotions fade away<CR>as you grow older.

records.jp: でも、あの時の気持ちはまだ覚えてる。<CR>ずっと忘れたくないな……
records.en_original: But still remember how I felt back then. I hope I never forget...
records.en: But still remember how I felt back then.<CR>I hope I never forget...

records.jp: ちょっと、うらやましいかも。<CR>私、“特別”なものって、あんまりないからさ
records.en_original: I'm kinda jealous. I don't think I have any special things like that.
records.en: I'm kinda jealous. I don't<CR>think I have any special things like that.

records.jp: そうなの？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: うん、好きなものはたくさんあるけどね
records.en_original: Yeah. There are a lot of things I like, though.
records.en: Yeah. There are a lot of things I like, though.

records.jp: もしかしたら、愛央ちゃんが気づいてないだけで<CR>もう、特別はあるかもしれないよ？
records.en_original: Maybe you do and you just haven't realized what they are yet.
records.en: Maybe you already have something special and<CR>just haven't noticed it, Ao-chan?

records.jp: 私が気づいてないだけで……
records.en_original: I just haven't realized...
records.en: I just haven't realized...

records.jp: ……あ、そうだ！<CR>ここで“特別”探してみようよ！
records.en_original: ...Oh, I know! Why don't we look for something "special" here?
records.en: ...Oh, I know! Why don't<CR>we look for something "special" here?

records.jp: この教室の中で、いいなって思ったものを<CR>見せあいっこするの
records.en_original: We can find something in this classroom that we think is cool and do show and tell.
records.en: We can find something in this classroom that we think is<CR>cool and do show and tell.

records.jp: おお、いいね！　やってみよっか！
records.en_original: Ooh, good idea! Let's do it!
records.en: Ooh, good idea! Let's do it!

records.jp: ……じゃあ、まずは私から！
records.en_original: Okay, I'll go first...
records.en: Okay, I'll go first...

records.jp: マカロンのラゲッジタグ！
records.en_original: This is luggage tag shaped like a macaron!
records.en: This is luggage tag shaped like a macaron!

records.jp: 鞄につける奴だね、可愛い！
records.en_original: Ohh, cute! I'd hang that on my bag.
records.en: Ohh, cute! I'd hang that on my bag.

records.jp: 干しっぱなしの靴下！　しかも片方！
records.en_original: A single sock that's been left out to dry!
records.en: A single sock that's been left out to dry!

records.jp: いきなりなんで！？　なんで、靴下！？
records.en_original: What?! Why a sock?!
records.en: What?! Why a sock?!

records.jp: いやー、完全に忘れられてる姿に<CR>なんか、キュンときたんだよね
records.en_original: I just felt sorry for it. It looked so lonely and abandoned.
records.en: I do not know. Seeing it completely forgotten there<CR>somehow tugged at my heart.

records.jp: あはは！　もう、愛央ちゃんってば。<CR>でも、特別ってそういうことだよね
records.en_original: Ahaha, jeez Ao! But I guess that could be considered special too.
records.en: Ahaha, jeez Ao-chan! But I guess that<CR>could be considered special too.

records.jp: ……じゃあ、次は私！
records.en_original: Okay, my turn!
records.en: Okay, my turn!

records.jp: イチゴキャンディの袋と……<CR>誰かが折った、折り鶴！
records.en_original: A bag of strawberry candies...and a paper crane someone folded!
records.en: A bag of strawberry candies...and a<CR>paper crane someone folded!

records.jp: ……えへへ、どうかな？
records.en_original: ...Eheh. What do you think?
records.en: ...Eheh. What do you think?

records.jp: 結構マニアックだね……？
records.en_original: They're certainly...interesting...
records.en: Those are pretty niche choices...?

records.jp: え、そう？<CR>みんな、可愛いなーと思ったんだけど
records.en_original: What? Really? Don't you think they're cute?
records.en: What? Really?<CR>Don't you think they're cute?

records.jp: とくにこの折り鶴！<CR>足がついてるんだよ、すごくない！？
records.en_original: Especially this paper crane! It's even got little legs! Isn't it amazing?!
records.en: Especially this paper crane!<CR>It's even got little legs! Isn't it amazing?!

records.jp: 誰が作ったのかなー。<CR>作り方教えてほしいなー……
records.en_original: I wonder who made it... I want them to show me how to do it.
records.en: I wonder who made it... I<CR>want them to show me how to do it.

records.jp: へぇ……それに、ときめいたんだ？
records.en_original: Hmm... Does that stuff spark joy?
records.en: Oh... That made your heart flutter?

records.jp: うん！　なんか、かわいいなーって♪
records.en_original: Yeah! I think it's kinda cute.
records.en: Yeah! I think it's kinda cute.

records.jp: ちょっと……ゴミっぽい
records.en_original: Looks kinda like...trash.
records.en: Looks kinda like...trash.

records.jp: もお！　ゴミじゃないよー！<CR>私はこれが可愛いと思ったの！
records.en_original: Hey! It's not trash! I think it's cute!
records.en: Hey! It's not trash!<CR>I think it's cute!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんの靴下と一緒だよ。<CR>この子たちに、キュンときちゃったんだもん
records.en_original: It's the same as your sock! Something about these just spoke to me.
records.en: It is the same as your socks, Ao-chan.<CR>These little guys made my heart skip a beat too.

records.jp: こういう直感は、信じないとね！
records.en_original: You have to listen to your heart!
records.en: You have to listen to your heart!

records.jp: ……まあ、私にしても陽桜莉さんにしても<CR>意外なものに、ときめいたりするね
records.en_original: ...Well, I guess we both found joy in some unexpected things.
records.en: ...Well, both Hiori-san and I get<CR>excited by unexpected things.

records.jp: 乙女心は、複雑ですからなー
records.en_original: A girl's heart is a complicated thing...
records.en: A girl's heart is a complicated thing...

records.jp: ……あ！　この教室の中で<CR>もうひとつ、特別なものあった！
records.en_original: Oh! There's one more special thing in this classroom!
records.en: Oh! There's one more<CR>special thing in this classroom!

records.jp: え、なになに？
records.en_original: Ooh! What is it?
records.en: Ooh! What is it?

records.jp: それはね……
records.en_original: That would be...
records.en: That would be...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんだよ
records.en_original: Hiori!
records.en: Hiori-san!

records.jp: ……ふぇ？
records.en_original: ...Wha?
records.en: ...Wha?

records.jp: だから、陽桜莉さん
records.en_original: Hiori, it's you!
records.en: Hiori-san, it's you!

records.jp: えっ！？　わ、私！？
records.en_original: Huh?! M-me?!
records.en: Huh?! M-me?!

records.jp: うん。他のみんなのことも大切だけど、<CR>陽桜莉さんは、やっぱり特別かなぁって
records.en_original: Yeah! Everyone else is important too, but you're really special to me, Hiori.
records.en: Yeah! Everyone else is important too, but<CR>you're really special to me, Hiori-san.

records.jp: も、もお！　何言ってるの、愛央ちゃん！
records.en_original: Wh-what are you talking about, Ao?
records.en: Wh-what are you talking about, Ao-chan?

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、顔が真っ赤だよ
records.en_original: Hiori, you're blushing!
records.en: Hiori-san, you're blushing!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんが、ドキドキさせるからだよ～！
records.en_original: You're making me blush, Ao!
records.en: Because you made my heart race, Ao-chan~!

records.jp: ど、どうしたの、愛央ちゃん？
records.en_original: Wh-what's the matter, Ao?
records.en: Wh-what's the matter, Ao-chan?

records.jp: いや、これで伝わらないかなーと思って
records.en_original: Nothing, I just thought you might be able to figure it out.
records.en: Nothing, I just thought you might be able to figure it out.

records.jp: 伝わるって何が？
records.en_original: Figure...what out?
records.en: Figure...what out?

records.jp: 私の特別なもの
records.en_original: My special thing.
records.en: My special thing.

records.jp: ……愛央ちゃんの特別？
records.en_original: Your special thing...?
records.en: ...Your special thing, Ao-chan?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: ええっ！？
records.en_original: Huhhh?!
records.en: Huhhh?!

records.jp: それって、もしかして……私？
records.en_original: You mean like...me?
records.en: You mean like...me?

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんの特別って私なの？
records.en_original: Your special thing is me?
records.en: Am I your special someone, Ao-chan?

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、なんとか言って！<CR>無言は、ずるいってば！
records.en_original: Say something, Ao! It's not fair!
records.en: Say something, Ao-chan!<CR>It's not fair!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃ～ん！！
records.en_original: AOOOO!!
records.en: AOOOO!!
